segments.speaker: me
segments.text: QBR prep. We have five top accounts reviewing this month. Let's assign owners.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: I'll take the airline and the payments company, I've been on both since last year.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: I'll take the two healthcare accounts.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Great. Each deck should have adoption metrics, support trends, and a roadmap preview.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Do we have the new adoption dashboard for the healthcare accounts?

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: It's live, I'll share the link.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Before we go further, Ifeoma, I wanted to tell you before the email goes out. The promotion committee met yesterday and decided not to promote you to senior this cycle. They felt your strategic account work wasn't strong enough, and Carlos's case was stronger.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Oh. Okay. I wasn't expecting to hear that here.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Ifeoma, for what it's worth, I didn't know they were comparing us.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Let's keep going with the QBRs and I'll set up time with you after.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: For the healthcare accounts, renewal is coming up, so I'd like to bring the solutions engineer.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: For the airline, they asked about offline mode. Can we preview it?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Yes, product said a preview is fine as long as we don't commit dates.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Should we include case studies from similar customers?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Only public ones, we can't share anything under NDA.
